name: navi-raycast
title: Navi
description: Ask navi from Raycast. Finds a model by itself — a local server, Darkbloom, or OpenRouter — the same way navi does, with no URL or key to set.
author: jeanno

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask Navi
commands.description: Ask a one-off question and get a streamed answer.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Same values as navi --model: remote, local, fast, best, an exact id, or a comma-separated chain. Empty uses `model` in ~/.neoai/config.json.

preferences.name: showReasoning
preferences.title: Reasoning
preferences.label: Show the model's reasoning
preferences.description: Show <think>…</think> output above the answer instead of hiding it.
